title: Rector
summary: Sergey Kondratyev, Rector of Admiral Ushakov State Maritime University.

body.text: The Rector is Sergey Ivanovich Kondratyev, Doctor of Technical Sciences and Professor. He leads the university’s strategic development and represents it in government and industry organisations.
Appointments are available by prior arrangement through the Rector’s Office.
